[[/hcell]] [[hcell colspan="3"]] Melon [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell colspan="3"]] Marron's counterpart, similar PAs with different Strike mechanic. Melon has lowest HP among all pets, but highest defense among all. Hold the Strike PA button after throwing melon to catch it back.

Melon size's stage is reached faster, needing only 1 hit for 2nd Stage and 2 hits for 3rd Stage. Melon will revert to 1st Stage after spending 15 seconds on 3rd Stage, instead of blowing up the player.

A ★14 Melon will have 5000 MEL Def (S-DEF), along with 300 more Pwr compared to Maron. [[/cell]] [[/row]]

Personality Description
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Underdog (逆境 Adverse//) 117% damage if HP drops below 25%. This is not activated during Melon Strike, unless Melon's HP is below 25% when using.
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Indefatigable (やせ我慢 Fierce//) A chance to recover 18% of max HP when taking damage. This is preferred to keep Melon on the defensive side.
[[image http:capa.wdfiles.com/local--files/guide:phantasy-star-online-2-summoner/Personality.png class="pet-personality"]]Cute// (キュート) ★14 only. Combines Underdog and Indefatigable, as well as having increased rare item drop rate.

[[table class="wiki-content-table border-top-none border-bottom-none"]] [[row]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Strength [[/hcell]] [[hcell class="border-top-none"]] Weakness [[/hcell]] [[/row]] [[row]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list pros w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Suitable against aggressive bosses
  • High Pwr
  • Highest Def
  • Has 5000 MEL Def at L130, reducing almost any Melee (Strike) damage to 1.
  • Can shield character from damage
  • High PP regain from normal attack
  • Has a high-powered DoT attack
  • Has a bouncing homing attack
  • Recovers quickly from stun

[[/cell]] [[cell class="pros-cons-list cons w-50 border-bottom-none"]]

  • Lowest HP
  • Not much use outside fighting boss
  • Somewhat not aggressive, despite being a melee pet

[[/cell]] [[/row]] [[/table]]

1 DPS: Damage Per Second, the higher the better.
2 Normal Attack DPS Rating: The DPS rating of Normal Attacks. Hold is the DPS if you hold the normal attack button. Auto is the number if you let the pet attack freely. If only Hold exists, then the pet will do less if you don't hold the button. The number in bracket is the restored PP per second, disregarding natural PP regen.
3 Overall DPS Rating: The greater the number, the greater the pet's DPS potential is. This is calculated by using Glance of Darkness with Rykros Staff +30, during standard case scenario: Phantom sub, enemy is weak to pet's element, enemy isn't moving, a pair of 110% damage parfaits, using PA to deplete 200PP, then use Normal Attacks to get back 200PP (boosted natural PP regen and attack PP regen due to Phantom sub is calculated).
4 Sweets in bold are currently what Manaka put on her pets. For more information about Sweets, see the [#recommended-candies Recommended Sweets] Section.

5 GoD: Total DPS when using Glance of Darkness, the potential of Rykros Staff at +30 grind or more. Only applies to a single target.
6 GoD Plus: Total DPS when using Glance of Darkness Plus, the Ultimate Booster potential of Rykros Staff at +30 grind or more. Only applies to a single target.
7 Higher efficiency means lower PP consumption. An efficiency of 100 means you can sustain the attack for a long time. Remember that the most efficient attack doesn't mean that it will do decent DPS.
